description: This class models an order summary used in e-commerce services, encapsulating shipping details and a list of shopping cart items.

classes.name: OrderSummary
classes.description: A serializable object used as input for order and tax calculation services, holding shipping and product details.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items for the order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items associated with the order.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the shipping summary details for the order.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping summary details associated with the order.
